name: custody-record
title: Sample custody working record
for_each: select id,code from samples order by code

sections.title: Recorded changes
sections.sql: select action,actor,note,created_at from events where sample_id=$1 order by created_at,id
sections.note: Actor labels are operator-entered. This is not a certified chain-of-custody document.

name: stocktake-sheet
title: Physical inventory check sheet
for_each: select id,code from boxes order by code

sections.title: Storage positions
sections.sql: select code,name,position,quantity,unit,status,held from samples where box_id=$1 order by position
sections.note: Check the physical position and quantity. Record differences before relying on the inventory.

name: conditions-review
title: Storage conditions review
for_each: select id,code from storage_units order by code

sections.title: Local operating range
sections.sql: select code,name,min_c,max_c,finding from storage_conditions where id=$1

sections.title: Manual observation history
sections.sql: select observed_at,temperature_c,actor,note from observations where storage_unit_id=$1 order by observed_at desc
sections.note: No live sensor connection, cold-chain certification or automatic alert.
